name: zvideo_buff_copy_surface_rect_to_image
description: zVideo_buff::CopySurfaceRectToImage selects a video surface state, clips the requested rectangle against the surface bounds, optionally creates a destination image, and copies 16-bit pixels row by row into the destination offset implied by left/top clipping.
known_limits: The smoke covers source selector 0 with left/top clipping into a caller-provided image. Other selector branches share the same copy loop after selecting the corresponding accepted surface-state globals.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo buffer/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4a6fe0 validates selector 0/1/2 surface-state choice, invalid-selector null return, pitch-to-word conversion, left/right/top/bottom clipping behavior, optional destination image allocation/setup, row-byte/stride computation, and 16-bit row copy loop.
The native smoke verifies left/top clipping mutates the source rect and copies the expected rows into the caller-provided destination image with the original-width stride.
